question: How much does a clinically explicit 60-second paired ECG priming session improve frozen REM-Net continuous reconstruction?
source: all 11 completed test prediction artifacts from q1_remnet_continuous_strict_loso_seed42
calibration: first chronological record, all 8-second windows ending at or before 60 seconds
boundary_rule: discard windows crossing 60 seconds; query begins at start_idx >= 60 seconds, so calibration and query share no source samples
parameters: one subject-level integer lag selected on [-150,+150] ms in 5-ms steps by calibration PCC; one global multiplicative std ratio
query: remaining windows of the first record plus every later record; calibration windows excluded
aggregation: per-window within fold, then fold-macro mean and population standard deviation over 11 held-out subjects
interpretation: paired calibration track only; must not replace or be described as strict zero-shot LOSO
